name: Local 3D Regression Hyperplane Gradient Estimation
definition: A high-quality gradient estimation method that approximates the gradient vector by estimating the density function itself in a local neighborhood.
summary: Local 3D Regression Hyperplane Gradient Estimation approximates volume gradients by fitting a local 3D regression hyperplane to density values, offering higher accuracy and smoother specular effects than simple finite differences at the cost of increased computation.
